newsitem.title: USA: Specialty Equipment sees difficult Q1 comparison.
newsitem.headline: Specialty Equipment sees difficult Q1 comparison.

text.p: Specialty Equipment Cos Inc said Thursday it expects a difficult comparison in the first quarter against last year's comparable period due to a very successful freezer trade-in program at that time.

In its first quarter last year, the company, which makes commercial cooking and refrigeration equipment for the food service industry, reported earnings of $7.1 million or $0.33 a share on revenues of $105.3 million.

Earlier today, Specialty Equipment reported earnings for its fiscal year ended January 31, 1997 rose to $32.3 million or $1.51 a share from $8.7 million or $0.41 a year earlier. Revenues increased to $401.2 million from $392.5 million.
The company attributed its gains to increased sales of refrigeration products to international soft drink bottlers and higher sales of ice cream freezer equipment.
"The projected growth of the international market continues to present a significant opportunity for us, said William Dotterweich, chief executive, in a statement.

Higher gross margins were held back by a larger percent of sales to the soft drink bottler market which carries lower than average gross margins, costs associated with a new plant and stiff price competition in the soft drink bottler market.
